source_path.description: Alternative to content: path (relative to the workspace root, or absolute inside it) of the artifact file. The server reads it, so the full text does not round-trip through the model. Exactly one of content / source_path / files.

rationale.description: At least 40 chars; tie the score to the cited evidence.

weakness.description: Concrete shortcoming, at least 10 chars; the literal "none" is allowed only when score is 10. Evasive wording (e.g. "not evaluated") is rejected.

items.description: Exactly one of three shapes, selected by kind. locator: {kind:"locator", locator:string(1-200), excerpt:string(20-2000, copied verbatim from ONE line of the committed artifact)}. command: {kind:"command", command:string(3-1000), exit_code:integer, output_excerpt:string(1-8000), output_sha256:hex64, target_digest?:"sha256:..."}. upstream: {kind:"upstream", upstream_locator:string(1-200), excerpt:string(20-2000 from the pinned upstream artifact)}. verification:"auto" criteria require at least one command evidence. The server also returns a filled example in next_action.input_skeleton.
